utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve heard the repair drive is already getting a pretty good turnout. If you want, I can let you know later what folks are bringing by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Tess — thank you. Just let me know what’s coming by, and we’ll see if anything else is needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know what’s coming by later. If I hear anything about timing or pickup too, I’ll pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just point me to what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I'll spread the word that volunteers are welcome, and if anyone has tools or basic repair supplies, that’d help too. I’ll send you the first spots to tackle as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send me the first spot when you have it, and I’ll grab whatever basic tools I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure yet, but I’ll ask around while I’m out and see what seems most urgent. If I hear anything useful, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay—just let me know once you’ve confirmed who’s bringing the repair items and who’s handling drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll ask around and confirm who’s bringing the repair items and who’s handling drop-off, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 works for me—I can coordinate around the school schedule. Let me know if that time still looks good for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 9 still works for me. What should I tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great—could you start by helping sort the donations and setting aside anything that needs repair? Then we can see what’s left after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m on my way to the corner lot now. I’ll help get everything loaded up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam—that’s helpful. I’ll tell everyone the pickup is at the corner lot, and I’ll make sure the timing gets passed along clearly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll see you at the corner lot and help load everything up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that should work—I’ll bring the tools and any small supplies I can find. If you can handle the bigger repair items, we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I’ll ask folks to share any broken items and any repair skills they’ve got, and I’ll keep nudging people about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, that sounds like a solid plan. I’ll keep gathering what I can and wait for your update on the bigger items.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’m still short on a hammer and some extra screws if anyone has them. I appreciate everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can bring a hammer and some extra screws. Let’s meet at the corner lot and head to the repair shop from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Eli — I’ll meet you at the corner lot. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a wrench set and a screwdriver I can lend out for the repair drive. I’ll swing by soon with them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great, Gus—thank you. I’ll let folks know you’re bringing tools by soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You’re welcome — happy to help. I’ll be there soon with the wrench set and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, can you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana—I’m a bit fuzzy on the latest list, but it was mostly small home fixes folks need help with. I should check the details again so I don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — please check the list when you can, and let me know the exact fixes and meeting spot so I can be ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the screwdriver, tape, and nails ready for the repair drive. Just let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo—that’s perfect. I’ll keep spreading the word and send anyone who needs help your way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Quinn — I’m ready on my end. Send them over if anyone needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can spread the word quietly around the block if that still helps. Just let me know what supplies you end up needing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot, thanks. I’m still tracking the repair drive spot, and if you hear a drop-off location, send it my way so I can note it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll listen around and let you know if I hear a drop-off spot. I’ll keep spreading the word quietly, too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries, Rosa — I’ll be there and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that really helps. It’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send out the update so everyone’s in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll head over and help where I can once I’m there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps—I just want to make sure I’ve got it right. Who’s handling the pickup, and is everything going to the repair shop by the corner lot?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m not sure about the pickup yet—I only know Cleo’s bringing the screwdriver and tape. And yes, it should all go to the repair shop by the corner lot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, thanks—I'll pass along that it’s going to the repair shop by the corner lot. Once the pickup is set, please let me know so I can share it clearly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like a good start. Let me know if you need me to quietly pass along what supplies are still missing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, that’d help a lot. I’ll keep nudging folks and ask them to share any broken items or repair skills they’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do that quietly. Just tell me what’s still missing, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly small home repairs—things like fixing loose doors, leaky faucets, and minor wall or fence issues. If you want, I can help share a simple list of needs and what supplies would be useful.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — that matches what I had in mind. If you can share the list and any supplies needed, I’ll check the details before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s looking pretty hopeful so far—folks are still pitching in, and I can pass along any timing updates if I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess — just let me know the time and spot when it’s set, and I’ll show up. I’m happy to start with the leaky faucet if that’s still on the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Bo — I’ll let you know the time and spot as soon as it’s set, and the leaky faucet is still a good place to start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo. If you find any gloves or a hammer too, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can do that — I’ll bring the wrench set, screwdriver, gloves, and a hammer soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — that covers it for now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — it’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. If you can spread the word, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll pass that along and keep an eye out in case it changes again.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything shifts again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem — I’ll be there and get started whenever you arrive. Thanks again for organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks — I’ll let you know when I’m on my way. I’m just a bit scattered today, so I might be a little late.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No worries — just text me when you’re on your way. I’ll be there and get started when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll let you know if anyone reaches out for help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep spreading the word and share any updates if I hear from anyone.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam—I've got the repair stuff and I'll meet you at the corner lot in about an hour.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll see you at the corner lot in an hour and help get everything loaded up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Sam — I’ll be there with the repair stuff in about an hour.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the screwdriver, plus the tape and spare nails I set aside. If you think of anything else for the repair drive, just tell me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that’s a great start. I’m still checking the school schedule, but once I know the timing I’ll let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just let me know the timing when you have it, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just making sure, Rosa’s handling both the repair items and the drop-off, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, Rosa’s got both covered.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm. And Leo, are you covering anything for the drive too?
